edition.civil_publication_deadline: before local sunrise in Corte on 2026-09-21
edition.dating_rule: The editorial day runs until local sunrise in Corte. Civil ISO timestamps remain unchanged and are recorded separately from the editorial date.

editorial_freedom.rule: Freeze the edition, never the next projection.
editorial_freedom.delta_role: Coverage and attention control only; Delta Review does not prescribe composition.

counterfactual_policy.rule: Non observable does not mean unknowable; grade strongly constrained counterfactuals instead of collapsing them into UNKNOWN.
counterfactual_policy.confidence_decay: Confidence decreases as intermediate events and causal links are added.

structural_center.status: structural hypothesis tested by Reality Cases, not imposed causal explanation
structural_center.formula: Detect configurations that reduce effective capacity; keep the Map open by exploring alternatives and objections; identify factors of conversion; then test whether effective capacity is actually restored or created.

book.function: Longer-lived methods, Reality Cases, invariants, Marie-Louise and Corsican historical/capability material.

magazine.function: Dated current-state layer: parliamentary continuity, senatorial litigation, political recompositions, new traces and status changes.

baseline: Munich Declaration of the Duties and Rights of Journalists 1971

scale_parallelism.invariance_rule: Transfer only relations that survive the change of scale without changing meaning; always record what does not transpose.
forbidden_transfer: cognitive constriction as a territorial mental state

political_documentation.community_arc: Communauté de destin → communauté de transmission → communauté en déclin ?

settler_colonialism_question.status: hypothesis/question to test; not an acquired characterization of contemporary Corsica

electoral_genealogy_candidate.rule: Separate documented traces, dated declarations and retrospective interpretation.

milestones.object: Kudocracy, liquid democracy, public/reversible voting and decision traces
subsequent electoral continuities and A Voce / Le Petit Parti relationships
Autonomie de Capacité / Une Corse capable
milestones.status: documented doctrine and dated electoral presentation

national_projection_candidate.name: France Capable
national_projection_candidate.status: candidate label introduced for future exploration
national_projection_candidate.requirement: Create a dedicated dated source before treating the label as stabilized Corpus state.

editorial_plan.title: La Machine à Empêcher
editorial_plan.function: Introduce the candidate mechanism at individual and collective scales, while preserving counterexamples and non-closures.
individual_material: Marie-Louise: frictions, loads, local closures, reopenings
collective_material: Corsica: nominal capacities, dependencies, procedures, capture points

editorial_plan.title: Ne pas fermer la Carte
editorial_plan.function: Show that the first response to blockage is epistemic: preserve contradictions, alternatives and UNKNOWN instead of manufacturing closure.

editorial_plan.title: La Machine à Explorer
editorial_plan.function: Search alternative routes, interlocutors, rules, infrastructures and bounded experiments at both scales.

editorial_plan.title: Du possible à la capacité effective
editorial_plan.function: Distinguish resources, conversion factors, effective capabilities, accessible actions, buffers, routes, time and exit.

editorial_plan.title: Machine à Rendre Capable
editorial_plan.function: Test whether identified possibilities can be converted into effective action without merely transferring dependency elsewhere.

editorial_plan.title: Reality Tests
editorial_plan.function: Use works, studies, elections, procedures and public Acts as tests that may confirm, bound or falsify parts of the model.

editorial_plan.title: Changer d'échelle sans tricher
editorial_plan.function: Compare relations across individual and collective scales, with an explicit row for non-invariants and a prohibition on collective psychology.

editorial_plan.title: Du laboratoire corse à l'échelle nationale
editorial_plan.function: Document the already-established 'Une Corse capable' horizon and expose 'France Capable' only as a candidate national projection requiring its own future source and Reality Tests.

editorial_plan.title: Le Réel répond
editorial_plan.function: Record successes, failures, refusals, silences, contradictions, witness input, abandoned hypotheses and other Reality responses.

editorial_plan.title: Journal de campagne contre l'impossible
editorial_plan.function: Human-readable delta of what the Corpus learned, corrected, opened, abandoned and deferred since the frozen anniversary edition.

identity_case.role: bounded documentary Reality Case inside Movement B; not the structural center of the edition
identity_case.projection_rule: Preserve person/account/address/display-name/document-name/context/source distinctions; do not infer psychology from multiplicity of names.

continuations.policy: Open work remains owned by its smallest sufficient locality.

contract.chapters_note: Editorial selection closed by explicit human decision on 2026-09-21. The order intentionally reuses current manuscript units in a double-helix composition instead of preserving the anniversary edition sequence.

outputs.masthead_rule: Identify final human editorial responsibility and actual AI assistance; legal publisher/director fields must be verified before final render.

contract.freeze_condition: Explicit editorial decision after provenance review, Delta Coverage review, and render verification. Freeze the resulting edition only; do not freeze the next editorial projection.
